findings.location: Proof, step 5.1: the assertion that curl F is a C1 field
findings.evidence: Only F in C1 is assumed. For F(x1,x2,x3)=(0,0,x1|x1|), curl F=(0,-2|x1|,0), which is continuous but not differentiable at x1=0. The flux definition requires only continuity, so the theorem can retain its statement by correcting this false regularity assertion; no C2 premise is available.
